name: LITERAL_OCTAHEDRON_EXACT_LIST_TERMINAL

domain.graph: A connected component Q that is exactly a literal K_{2,2,2} on six actual vertices.
domain.lists: Exact current lists L(v) subseteq [4], after all fixed-boundary restrictions have already been propagated into the lists.

algorithm: Reject assignments violating any exact list L(v).
Reject assignments improper on any edge of Q.
If one assignment survives, return COLORABLE with that explicit six-vertex coloring.
If none survives, return CONTRADICTION/UNSAT with the exhaustive assignment-count receipt.

complexity.conclusion: Constant-time with respect to the ambient residual size; hence polynomial.

graph_discovery.test: Verify Q has six vertices and is isomorphic to K_{2,2,2}: exactly three disjoint nonedges forming the three independent pairs, all twelve cross-part edges present.

target_claims: Exact arbitrary-list coloring of a literal six-vertex octahedron over palette [4] is decidable by direct finite enumeration.
The terminal is proof-carrying and uses neither an extension oracle nor a general P7-free 4-coloring solver.
The terminal applies only when the whole component is exactly the literal octahedron.
forbidden: Generalize to arbitrary octahedron minors represented by branch sets.
Generalize to arbitrary components merely containing an octahedron.
Use extension knowledge to choose assignments.
